newsitem.title: USA: Search Financial deal to boost receivables.
newsitem.headline: Search Financial deal to boost receivables.

text.p: Search Financial Services Inc said Tuesday that its previously announced deal to acquire MS Financial Inc, a non-prime auto finance company based in Jackson, Miss., would more than double its gross auto receivables under management.
George Evans, Search's chairman and chief executive said the deal is expected to close in June.

When the deal was announced in February, Evans said that if the deal was completed, its pro forma estimates show that the receivables under management would rise to about $250 million from $74.7 million.

Robert Idzi, chief financial officer of Search, said that the estimate today was based on MS Financial's actual March data, which shows the Mississippi company's portfolio rising to $141 million, from $62 million.
But he noted that on a pro forma basis, the acquisition would still increase Search's gross receivables "to about $203 million."
He noted that since the deal is expected to close in June, the final figures may be different, depending on loan portfolio movements.
Search Financial is a specialized financial services company that buys, finances and services non-prime automobile installment loans originated by franchised and independent automobile dealers.
The company also engages in non-auto consumer finance operations.
